name: vk-booking-manager
description: Booking and scheduling manager tailored for multi-staff service providers.

scripts.build:free: node bin/switch-resource-config-dev.js free && npm run build
scripts.build:pro: node bin/switch-resource-config-dev.js pro && npm run build
scripts.env:start:free: npm run dist:free && WP_ENV_PORT=${VKBM_FREE_PORT:-8892} wp-env start --config .wp-env-free.json
scripts.update: ncu -u --target minor -x 'sass @babel/core @babel/preset-env @babel/preset-react' && rimraf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.upgrade: ncu -u --target latest -x 'sass @babel/core @babel/preset-env @babel/preset-react' && rimraf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.dist:stage:free: mkdir -p dist/vk-booking-manager && rsync -a --delete --exclude='.*' --exclude='bin' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='dist' --exclude='docs' --exclude='*.zip' --exclude='vendor' --exclude='readme.md' --exclude='README-FREE.md' --exclude='AGENT.md' --exclude='AGENTS.md' ./ dist/vk-booking-manager && cd dist/vk-booking-manager && composer install --no-dev --prefer-dist --no-interaction --no-progress --optimize-autoloader && cd ../.. && node bin/switch-resource-config.js free
scripts.dist:stage:pro: mkdir -p dist/vk-booking-manager-pro && rsync -a --delete --exclude='.*' --exclude='bin' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='dist' --exclude='docs' --exclude='*.zip' --exclude='vendor' --exclude='tests' --exclude='test' --exclude='readme.md' --exclude='README-FREE.md' --exclude='AGENT.md' --exclude='AGENTS.md' ./ dist/vk-booking-manager-pro && cd dist/vk-booking-manager-pro && composer install --no-dev --prefer-dist --no-interaction --no-progress --optimize-autoloader && cd ../.. && node bin/switch-resource-config.js pro vk-booking-manager-pro
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:prepare && npm-run-all -s dist:stage:free dist:stage:pro
scripts.dist:free: npm run dist:prepare && npm run dist:stage:free
scripts.dist:pro: npm run dist:prepare && npm run dist:stage:pro
scripts.zip:free: npm run dist:free && npm run zip:free:from-dist
scripts.zip:pro: npm run dist:pro && npm run zip:pro:from-dist
scripts.zip:free:from-dist: cd dist && rm -f vk-booking-manager.zip && zip -qr vk-booking-manager.zip vk-booking-manager
scripts.zip:pro:from-dist: cd dist && rm -f vk-booking-manager-pro.zip && zip -qr vk-booking-manager-pro.zip vk-booking-manager-pro -x "vk-booking-manager-pro/.gitignore"
scripts.zip:all: npm run dist:all && npm-run-all -s zip:free:from-dist zip:pro:from-dist
